[[Briahn's Guidance]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Briahn the Chosen]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Mirror of Lyss]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Command]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Health]] +45 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This shield uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Aureate Aegis]], [[dye]]d a mix of green, blue and grey.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Heraldic Shield]] from collector [[Munashe]] or crafters [[Grif Ebonmane]], [[Kehjim]], or [[Wisseh]].

**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]

**[[Deldrimor Shield]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
